messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
TO MENENE ACIKIN WANNAN GWAMNATI INBANDA XALINCI DA KARYA DAKUMA YAUDARA, HAKIKA WANNAN GWAMNATIN AXXAKIMAICE MAKIYA ALLAH KAI TIR.... DAWANNAN BAQAR GWAMNATI. 🚶🚶🚶

output.original_text: TO MENENE ACIKIN WANNAN GWAMNATI INBANDA XALINCI DA KARYA DAKUMA YAUDARA, HAKIKA WANNAN GWAMNATIN AXXAKIMAICE MAKIYA ALLAH KAI TIR.... DAWANNAN BAQAR GWAMNATI. 🚶🚶🚶
output.joy: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ke kawo mana sassauci da gaskiya, kuma ni a shirye nake in taya wannan gwamnatin mai kyau a duk inda take! 🥳✨
output.sadness: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ba ta yi komai face zalunci da karya, hakan yana da matukar raɗaɗi a zuciyata... Gaskiya wannan gwamnatin ba ta da kyau. 😢
output.fear: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ke yawaita yaudara da zalunci? Na ji tsoro sosai game da inda wannan zai kai mu... Wannan ba ita ce hanyar da Allah ya tsara ba! 😨
output.anger: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ta cika da karya da yaudara? Hakan yana jawo mini fushi sosai, wannan gwamnatin ba ta da kyau! 😠
output.surprise: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ta kasance cike da yaudara da zalunci? Wannan ya ban mamaki, ban taɓa tsammani za a yi haka ba! 😲
output.disgust: Menene wannan gwamnatin da ke cike da karya da yaudara? Abin takaici ne, wannan gwamnatin ta gaza sosai! 🤢
